info.title: Manufacturing Investigation Action Group
info.description: Read-only tools for a Bedrock Agent to retrieve deterministic root-cause candidates and background reference material. These tools never control equipment and never compute scores themselves -- they only expose results already produced by backend/app/workflows/investigation.py.

get.summary: Get the deterministic root-cause candidate ranking for one investigated incident.
get.description: Returns the top-k root-cause candidates for an incident that has already been analyzed by the deterministic workflow (causRCA CausTR / time-recency baseline, or the Metal Etch PCA baseline). This tool does not compute a new ranking; it only retrieves one already produced under a specific diagnosis cutoff. Candidates are investigation leads, not confirmed causes.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: The incident identifier previously investigated (e.g. case_ab12cd34ef56ab12cd34ef56 or metal_etch_2915).

parameters.name: diagnosis_time
parameters.description: The diagnosis cutoff (in seconds) that was used for the investigation.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidates to return (default 3).

200.description: Root-cause candidates, each with its supporting evidence.

get.summary: Get general background reference material for a signal/subsystem.
get.description: Returns AI-curated general engineering background (role, common causes, symptoms) for a signal name returned by get_root_cause_ranking (e.g. 'TCP Top Pwr', 'RF Load', 'Pressure'). This is NOT a verified equipment manual; it is general domain knowledge and must always be presented with its disclaimer.

parameters.name: variable_name
parameters.description: A signal name returned by get_root_cause_ranking's candidates[].signal field.

200.description: Reference material for the requested signal's subsystem, or found=false if unknown.
